## A section heading

A line starting with ## (two #) is a section heading: it is listed in
"In this article" at the top of the page. Bold is written **like this**. A
link to this site is written [like this](/networks/stellar), a link to
another site [like this](https://example.com).

- A list item starts with a hyphen and a space.

To add an image: upload it to public/images/blog/, named after the article
